title: CPSC, PlayWell Toy Company Ltd. Announce Recall of Activity Cubes
summary: Small parts can detach from the cube, posing a choking hazard to small children. Units: 11,200.

title: CPSC, Meijer Announce Recall of Children's Sweatshirts with Drawstring Hoods
summary: The sweatshirts have drawstrings in the hood. Children can get entangled and strangle in the drawstrings, that can catch on playground equipment, fences or tree branches. Units: 18,655.

title: CPSC, Meijer Distribution Announce Recall of Children's Jackets
summary: The zipper pull on the jacket can come off and pose a choking hazard to small children. Units: 58,000.

title: CPSC, Swing-N-Slide Announce Recall of "Mega Rider" Swings
summary: The plastic handle on the Mega Rider swing could crack at the seat connection, allowing the metal connecting rod to pull out. If this occurs, a child on the swing could fall to the ground. Units: 1,220.

title: CPSC, Dorcy International Announce Recall of Fuji Batteries Sold with Dorcy Xenon Flashlights
summary: The batteries may overheat, leak, or rupture, presenting a potential for fire and injury. Units: 20,000.

title: CPSC, Grand Hall Announce Recall of Gas Grills to Repair Temperature Gauges
summary: If moisture gets inside the temperature gauge, the glass cover on the gauge can break, posing a risk of injury to people nearby. Units: 162,000.

title: CPSC, Mary Meyer Corp. Announce Recall To Replace Plush Spider Baby Toys
summary: The round stuffed feet on the spider can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 10,000.

title: CPSC, Ariens Co. Announce Recall of Snow Throwers
summary: The blade may not stop when the blade brake control is applied, resulting in continued blade movement. The potential for injury exists if consumers make contact with the rotary blade. Units: 571.

title: CPSC, GE Security, Inc. Announce Recall of Carbon Monoxide Alarms
summary: The recalled units fail to detect carbon monoxide after 1 year of operation, due to an internal software error. These CO alarms do not provide an "end of life" signal or other indication of inoperability, even if the test button is depressed. Units: About 74,000.

title: CPSC, Lamson & Sessions Inc. Announce Recall of Drop-In Floor Box
summary: The recalled floor boxes contain undersized wires and are wired with the polarity reversed. These problems present a risk of shock or electrocution and a possible fire hazard. Units: 7,000.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Accessory Skis for Snowmobiles
summary: The accessory skis sold for Polaris snowmobiles could break, resulting in injury or death. Units: 1,700.

title: CPSC, Progress Lighting Announce Recall of Fluorescent Light Fixtures
summary: The lamp holders on the fluorescent lights can overheat, causing the fixture to melt or burn, presenting a fire hazard. Units: 11,000.

title: CPSC, Dollar Tree Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Candle Sets
summary: Paint on the exterior surface of the candles can sustain a flame, posing a potential fire hazard. Units: 68,400.

title: CPSC, Fromm International-Solis® USA Announce Recall of Hair Dryers
summary: These hair dryers do not have an immersion protection device or ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) on the power cord, which poses a serious electrocution hazard if dropped in water. Units: 16,500.

title: CPSC, Bloomingdale's By Mail Announce Recall of Candleholders
summary: The candleholders can tip over, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: 300.

title: CPSC, Honeywell Video System Announce Recall of Security Camera
summary: The security camera's plastic mounting assembly can crack, allowing the dome and the camera to fall from the wall or ceiling, possibly injuring someone. Units: 689.

title: CPSC, Quality Fresh Cigars Announce Recall of Lighters
summary: These novelty lighters were imported without first being tested to show compliance with CPSC requirements that the lighters be child-resistant. They pose fire and burn hazards to young children. Units: 313.

title: CPSC, Schylling Associates Announce Recall of Wooden Music Radio Boxes
summary: A wooden turning knob and antenna top can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children and exposing a sharp point. Units: 15,600.

title: CPSC, Child Craft Industries Announce Recall of Cribs
summary: The slats on the drop side rail can loosen and detach. When this happens, the space created by the gaps can allow a baby to become entangled, strangle or fall. Units: 3,500.
